column1: # Exact retained synchronous replica-read tests for Campaign 13.

column8: note
Known-leader replacement updates the exact cached peer used by the next synchronous selection; broad cache lifecycle remains external.
Repeated leader observations preserve one exact leader authority; concurrent and background cache behavior remains external.
Missing and stale leader observations follow the bounded synchronous transition rules; the rest of RegionCache remains external.
A failed selected route does not invent a leader change, and reselection remains request scoped. Background recovery remains external.
Shared store failures exclude the exact failed generations across synchronous peer selection; concurrent failure races and background recovery remain external.
Follower mode selects a legal nonleader voter and preserves the cached leader across success; labels, load, and async dispatch remain external.
Mixed mode rotates a request-owned access path and retains legal leader fallback; load, slow-score, and async policy remain external.
A no-leader observation advances through legal peers without promoting an unproven leader; broad cache reload behavior remains external.
The synchronous selector switches peer under a nil-leader response while preserving one attempt budget; proxy and async sends remain external.
Known-leader information changes the synchronous selector state before the next dispatch; proxy and async sends remain external.
Learner mode admits only legal learner peers and fails closed when none exist; production learner provisioning and async dispatch remain external.
One synchronous selector owns peer order and attempt transitions for a query; forwarding, proxy, load, and async paths remain external.
Follower selection excludes the exact unreachable store generation and reaches a legal surviving voter; background recovery remains external.
Replica policy returns to leader semantics after the typed synchronous transition without a second retry authority; async and proxy paths remain external.
Stale-read request flags survive synchronous timeout rotation to a legal follower; flashback, load, and async behavior remain external.
The exact unreachable cached leader is excluded before synchronous dispatch; health loops and background recovery remain external.
Prefer-leader mode tries the legal leader first and retains bounded nonleader fallback; load and async policy remain external.
Basic legal-peer admission, stale metadata rejection, and deterministic synchronous order execute; NextGen, scoring, proxy, and async features remain unclaimed.
The retained synchronous access-path cases execute for the supported modes; the adjacent async entry point remains UNTRIAGED.
The second retained synchronous access-path matrix executes; its async counterpart remains UNTRIAGED.
Basic synchronous leader and failure transitions execute under the shared selector; busy, proxy, and async branches remain external.
Known and missing leader transitions execute without splitting cache authority; proxy, busy, and async paths remain external.
Follower synchronous peer ordering and legal fallback execute; load, slow-score, proxy, and async paths remain external.
Mixed and prefer-leader synchronous paths share one query seed and legal fallback sequence; load and async policy remain external.
Stale-read flags and synchronous follower rotation execute; flashback, proxy, load, and async paths remain external.
Learner-only synchronous admission and fail-closed exhaustion execute; production learner topology and async policy remain external.
